title: Bergmanite
summary: BERG'MANITE, noun [from Bergman, the mineralogist.] A mineral classed with scapolite, in the family of felspath. It occurs massive, with gray and red quartz in Norway. Its colors are greenish and gray

inlines.v: BERG'MANITE, noun [from Bergman, the mineralogist.] A mineral classed with scapolite, in the family of felspath. It occurs massive, with gray and red quartz in Norway. Its colors are greenish and grayish white.
